recent_posts.title: AI-First Mindset: How AI is Reshaping Teams and Leadership
recent_posts.summary: A tech leader shares her journey developing an AI-first mindset, inspired by Ethan Mollick's 'Co-Intelligence'. She outlines how she moved from basic AI usage to building reusable AI-assisted workflows, then extended that thinking to her team. Key themes include: staying problem-focused rather than solution-led when adopting AI, the importance of psychological safety for team-wide experimentation, treating AI adoption as change management, and maintaining personal accountability for all AI-generated outputs. Practical advice covers spec-driven development as a guardrail, celebrating failed experiments, and developing resilience and analytical thinking as the most critical skills in a fast-changing AI landscape.

recent_posts.title: Maximizing your career with effective mentorship
recent_posts.summary: Being a mentee offers valuable insights and experiences from seasoned professionals that can enhance your skills, expand your network, and help you adapt to workplace culture. Successful mentees are committed, receptive to feedback, and take initiative in maintaining the relationship. Best practices for remote mentorship include frequent check-ins and empathetic communication. The RISE development plan (Review, Identify, Systemize, Evaluate) provides a structured approach for personal growth during mentorship. Building a strong mentor-mentee relationship involves respect, honesty, and clear communication. Developing confidence and utilizing techniques like positive affirmations and visualization can further enhance the mentoring experience.

recent_posts.title: Unlocking Potential: The Mentor’s Role
recent_posts.summary: Mentoring is a reciprocal journey that benefits both mentors and mentees. Mentors refine their skills and gain new perspectives, while mentees receive guidance and support. The post outlines the benefits of mentoring, best practices for remote mentoring, different mentoring styles, and tips for building effective mentor-mentee relationships. It emphasizes the importance of mutual respect and consistent communication.

recent_posts.title: Mentoring – LOG Framework
recent_posts.summary: Mentoring has a powerful positive impact on an individual’s professional growth and is essential for teams and organizations that want to thrive in a post-pandemic world. It is a two-way street relationship between a mentor and a mentee, sharing skills, knowledge, experiences, and feedback. Research shows that mentoring can develop leadership skills, accelerate professional development, increase the likelihood of a raise and enrollment in college, and lead to salary-grade changes.

recent_posts.title: The Culture Map by Erin Meyer
recent_posts.summary: Erin Meyer's 'The Culture Map' provides a systematic approach to understanding business communications challenges in a global context. It explores topics such as communicating across cultures, evaluating performance, persuasion, leadership styles, decision-making, trust, and perceptions of time.

recent_posts.title: Prometheus for Managers – Alerting
recent_posts.summary: This post discusses the use of Prometheus for setting up alerts and covers topics such as recording rules and alerting rules. It also explains the purpose of AlertManager in handling and sending notifications for alerts.

recent_posts.title: Leadership Circles™ at Adobe – A Personal Journey
recent_posts.summary: Leadership Circles at Adobe is a program that helps individuals develop their personal leadership and achieve success. It is based on the book The Inner Edge: The 10 Practices of Personal Leadership. The program lasts for about 1 year and includes monthly sessions and coaching. The 10 practices of Personal Leadership include getting clarity, finding focus, taking action, tapping into your brilliance, feeling fulfillment, maximizing your time, building your team, keeping learning, seeing possibilities, and integrating all aspects for excellence.

recent_posts.title: Prometheus for Managers – PromQL
recent_posts.summary: This post explores the main concepts of PromQL, including time series data, metrics, labels, vectors, and scalars. It also covers functions for manipulating and analyzing time series data, such as aggregation functions and data type transformation functions.

recent_posts.title: Prometheus for Managers – Prometheus Architecture
recent_posts.summary: This article provides essential insights and architectural concepts about Prometheus for managers aiming to harness its power within their teams. It covers Prometheus terminology, Prometheus architecture components (server, targets, alerting, data visualization), and key aspects of each component.

recent_posts.title: Prometheus for Managers – Intro
recent_posts.summary: Prometheus is an open-source, metrics-driven monitoring system that enables us to analyse the performance of our applications and infrastructure. With a specific focus on the metrics space, Prometheus provides valuable insights into how our systems are operating. In this post, we will delve into the fundamental concepts associated with monitoring.
